title: 五步在家学会侧手翻
note: The note URL was not recorded when the clip was cut (2026-10-25). The kept clip is the 78-frame, 402x720 clip GVHMR used, cropped to rows 150-573 so that no app UI remains (title band above, uploader avatar / name / caption / chapter bar below); the zooming camera cuts the feet in the last frames. Frames 44-58 (fast inverted-to-upright phase, head lost by the detector) got extra hand-set head boxes (scripts/data/mosaic/patch_cartwheel_2.py).
face_mosaic: yolov8n-pose (ultralytics 8.2.42) per frame, plus a 180-degree-rotated pass when the head keypoints are missing (inverted bodies); face box from nose/eyes/ears (1.6x their span, >= 6% of frame height and >= 0.2 x the clip person size), shoulder/box-top fallback, union over +-3 frames, last box reused when nothing is detected; pixelated with block size = box/7. Every person detected (conf >= 0.15) is mosaicked.
